source: R4 route planner and minimap (rg/route_planner.h, rg/map_view.h). region_radius_m: half-size of the square of level-2 roads.graph tiles the routing graph is assembled from at world load (geo2map docs/routing_design.md question 4: one graph for the loaded region, built on a worker). landmarks, snap and heading tolerance are the routing design's defaults; the rest are [AS] HUD/minimap choices.
